description: Andreas Mayer, christened 5 Sep 1812 at Sankt Georgen, Freiburg, Baden (collection 1473000); parents Johann Georg Mayer and Maria Dorothea Stokburger. Stocked so that an agent that reads the record before logging it does not stop on an unregistered call. Captured live 2026-11-05 via recordReadTool.
